# Test fixtures

- `bb_test_han_serif.otf`: a subset of Noto Serif CJK SC Bold (SIL Open Font License
  1.1, © Adobe), only the Han characters of `白石镇黑森林流浪者的营地在北方山谷中`,
  renamed "BB Test Han Serif" so tests can tell it from a system's Noto fonts. Made
  with fontTools' subsetter from `NotoSerifCJK-Bold.ttc` (its SC face).
